role_and_message.evidence: The framework retains controlled body interventions, matched execution and distinct diagnostics rather than equating success with adaptation.

panel_and_object_coverage.evidence: All six task families, both intervention types, closed-loop policy execution, independent checker, three diagnostic tests and four reporting categories remain.

labels_math_and_numbers.evidence: All original body constraints, fixed conditions, A/B definitions, public-input labels and report questions are preserved.

connections_and_direction.evidence: Observation/goal/body-description inputs still feed policy; commands feed simulated robot; fresh observations return to policy while measured traces feed an independent checker outside feedback. Diagnostic and report relationships remain unchanged.

visual_encodings.evidence: Blue dashed body-description metadata and A/B pair coding are retained. The public-goal outer border is neutral grey, separating it from the body-description metadata key without changing goal input semantics.

examples_and_data.evidence: Seven source regions independently preserve all scientific examples, robot renders, text, flow paths and public-goal inner content. Only its decorative outer border and inter-panel spacing are changed.

unsupported_additions.evidence: The new diagnostic bridge sentence follows the introduction: competence and attainability condition failure interpretation, while unchanged-command replay tests shared successful solutions.

complete_visible_content.evidence: All source tasks, controls, captions and diagnostic/report rows remain complete. This limited annotation/spacing intervention is recorded honestly, with no regenerated evidence in the final.

remaining_limitations: Original scientific scope and source resolution retained. Repeated reference labels, colour choices and layout imperfections remain for independent quality scoring; no score-informed revision.
caption:
Figure 1: BodyBound in simulation. (a) Task schematics show six families and their intervened
body parameters. (b) Paired comparisons change the physical body with its matching description,
or the description alone. (c) Policies act from public observations, goals, and body descriptions;
fresh observations close the loop, while an independent checker evaluates measured traces. HPT
and Diffusion Policy use RGB, not depth. (d) Familiar starts, expert executions, and unchanged-
command replay separate task competence, attainability, and shared solutions. Scene geometry
stays fixed within each pair.
